notes.title: v1.6 -> v1.6.1 Changelog
notes.notes: Fixed issue where the game would pause when the player first starts it when using mouse controls.

notes.title: v1.5 -> v1.6 Changelog
notes.notes:
Improved sprite rendering (fixes shimmering artifacts).
Upgraded to the latest Steamworks SDK.
Added workarounds for mouse related issues when running the game on Steam Deck.
Polished various aspects of in-game rendering.
Polished UI.

notes.title: Changelog for v1.4.3->v1.5.
notes.notes:
Add support for controllers to Android port.
Add support for keyboard to Android port.
Add support for mouse to Android port.
Add support for adaptive icons on Android.
Rewrite touch input handling. Movement is now relative instead of absolute. This makes the game more playable on non-mobile touch screens since the user won't have to obscure their view of the playfield.
Add support for landscape orientation on Android.
Fix issue with input system that could cause controller states to read incorrectly under certain circumstances.
Add loading screen.
Fix bug which would cause touch input to stop working on Windows after a short amount of time.
Don't show the leaderboard screen when quitting the game from the pause menu.
Always show 'Play Again?' menu after losing the game.
Fix some minor issues with the interface.
Graphics changes related to touch input changes.
Clean up source code a bit.

notes.title: Changelog for v1.4.2->v1.4.3.
notes.notes:
Fix bug which made submitting scores to the leaderboards fail the first time the game is run.
Fix issues in server-side leaderboard code which could prevent scores from uploading properly.

notes.title: Changelog for v1.4.1->v1.4.2
notes.notes:
Fix bug which could cause achievements to randomly trigger the first time the game is run.
Fix various issues with mouse input.
Fix WASD menu controls.

notes.title: Changelog for v1.4->v1.41
notes.notes:
Fix issue where setting mouse sensitivity could confine the player to a smaller portion of the playfield on Windows and Linux.
Fix issue where some mouse inputs could be ignored for a bit shortly after touching the edge of the playfield.

notes.title: Changelog for v1.3->v1.4.
notes.notes:
Add difficulty selection.
Add mouse sensitivity settings.
Fix bug which caused high score to upload even if the upload scores option was turned off.
Fix bug which caused high score not to save if user exited the game from the pause menu.
